release_notes: Unify Dashboard order management on `/admin/operations/orders` while preserving strict server-side B2B/B2C channel isolation and store scope. Redirect legacy B2B and B2C order pages to the canonical Operations surface and remove duplicate order-management navigation entries. Keep contextual order actions under the three-dot menu, including permitted edit/re-price, status, B2B Van dispatch, B2C Driver dispatch/reminder, and finance-authorized invoice access. Add pending-order editing through the existing authoritative `AdminOrderManagementService`; paid, issued/locked, and non-pending orders remain non-editable. Add regression coverage for cross-channel denial, canonical legacy redirects, and contextual action rendering. Dashboard-only update: no database migrations and no Customer, Driver, or Van runtime source changes.
